about.title: About the adventurer
about.body: Engineer passionate about coding, based in France. I love building complete products — from a dockerized backend to a polished UI — and actually shipping them to production. Here is the map of my realm.

codexio.description: A Django site showcasing my comics collection, built on a clean hexagonal architecture (domain / application / infrastructure). Fully dockerized for reproducible deployments.

rimbot.description: A dockerized monorepo: Flask API + seeded PostgreSQL database + React (Vite) front. Generates random poems with syllable handling, all covered by unit, integration and e2e tests in CI.

thecode-website.description: TheCode's landing page and online password generator. From a secret key and a site name, SHA-256 always yields the same password — nothing is stored or transmitted. Doc hub with links to every app.

speciarium.description: A Django platform for cataloguing species: taxonomy synced with GBIF, interactive map, photo gallery with EXIF extraction, collaborative collections and real-time notifications over WebSockets (Channels + Redis).

lilianastrade.description: A Symfony app to manage Magic: The Gathering card collections and decks. Multi-user management, automated deployment with Deployer.

jimi.description: A chat-driven calendar assistant. The Spring Boot 3 backend extracts an event from a natural-language message ("plan a meeting tomorrow at 2pm") via an LLM and CRUDs it in a MariaDB database. The Expo / React Native client runs on iOS, Android and Web; a schedule page reads straight from the database, with no risk of hallucination. The Android app is published on the Play Store.

thecode-apple.description: Native Swift apps for iPhone and Mac, with built-in Safari extensions. Local, deterministic password generation with zero storage — the TheCode experience across the Apple ecosystem.

thecode-android.description: An Android app in Java + Material Design 3: deterministic SHA-256 generation, entropy meter, system autofill (Android 8+) with biometric auth. 100% offline, no account.

thecode-extension.description: A cross-browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, Safari) that detects password fields and suggests a deterministic password from the session key + domain. Unit-tested algorithm, no storage.

thecode-cli.description: The Python CLI version of TheCode, sharing the same logic as the extension and website. Pip install, scriptable output, MIT license, tests and CodeQL in CI.

exif-tools.description: A Python desktop app (packaged with PyInstaller) to view and edit a photo's metadata: capture date, GPS coordinates editable on an interactive map.
